result: Spatial work-precision benchmark completed across 4 problems (sphere-photon-2d, semilinear-advection-diffusion-2d, semilinear-advection-diffusion-3d, sphere-photon-3d) from clean worktree with verified build source (dirty_source_allowed=false). vigilode-dense and vigilode-banded-dense ran as primary endpoint-only arms taking output_clipped_steps == 0 on the 101-point evaluation grid (protocol-violation rows == 0), while vigilode and vigilode-banded were preserved as separate grid-clipped continuity controls. All 953 matched-error comparison rows were reported as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY due to either unbracketed error regimes or cross-family reference disputes (semilinear 2d/3d cross-family discrepancy exceeded 1e-10 at initial tolerance). All wall-clock timings were strictly maintained under timing_authority: diagnostic_only. Zero unbracketed speedup or performance ranking ratios were admitted.
limitations: In-process timing remains diagnostic_only; no claims of production speedup or ranking over Sundials/DiffSol are admitted without pre-registered multi-run timing authority.
Agreement with numerical reference solvers on discrete observation grids does not constitute a rigorous continuous-time validated trajectory enclosure.
